scripts.check: npm run check:backend && npm run check:frontend
scripts.check:backend: node scripts/run-python.cjs -m ruff check backend tests workspace_runner.py && node scripts/run-python.cjs -m pytest -q tests/test_backend_application.py tests/test_sqlite_repositories.py tests/test_worker_service.py tests/test_phase0_contracts.py tests/test_job_dedupe.py
scripts.dev: concurrently --names "API,WORKER,UI" --prefix-colors "cyan,yellow,magenta" "node scripts/run-python.cjs workspace_runner.py serve-api" "node scripts/run-python.cjs workspace_runner.py run-worker --worker-id local_worker" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.pm2:prod: npm run build && pm2 start ecosystem.config.cjs --env production && pm2 save
